title: 第一卷 第1章 七宝葫芦第一卷 第2章 你有血光之灾
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了
content_zh:
;;
苍玄界，长生观。
道观之中早已没有了香火，四处破败不堪，地面上的青砖裂缝里都遍布杂草，这里与其说是道观，都不如说是贫民窟。
道观中一处荒凉的小院。
李寒舟正在屋内发呆。
他怎么也没有想到事情会变成现在这个样子。
他并非是苍玄界的人，而是来自一个叫做地球的地方。
从小无父无母，被一个老道士给捡了回去，生活在道观中。
老道士传授他风水相术，算命占卜，画符驱魔，还有道门心法。然而这些东西在李寒舟看来都不过是骗人的把戏，只是是为了骗一口饭钱而已，这世界上哪来的妖魔？
还有那道门心法，老道士修炼到死没有修炼出一缕灵气。
直到老道士去世以后，道观被拆，李寒舟也不得已靠着这些本事骗口饭吃。
晚上在网上直播给人算命看风水，白天的时候开了个修理站，帮人修理家电什么的。
日子清贫但也能过得去，而就在三天前，李寒舟终于得到了上天的眷顾，他买的彩票居然中奖了，足足中了三千万！
钱已经到账，李寒舟在惊喜之余，发现自己修炼多年的道门心法竟然在身体之中产生了一缕灵气，这让李寒舟更是惊喜交加，没想到所有的幸运都出现在了同一天！
然而伴随着这一缕灵气的出现，李寒舟眼前一黑，再次醒来的时候就出现在了这里。
他穿越了！
李寒舟很想大骂老天为什么要这么玩他。
自己有三千万，美好的人生刚要开始，就来了这么一个鬼地方！
“师叔，师叔，您到底好了没有啊？明天太玄圣地的考核就要开始了，你的灵宝做出来没有呢？”这个时候，门外传来了一个焦急的督促声。
李寒舟顺着门缝往外一看，院子里站着三个人，两个少年，以及一个小女孩。

“哎，快了，再等等。”李寒舟只好敷衍着说。
转过身，李寒舟就有些头疼。
这长生观说是一个宗门，但是早已落魄至极，宗主一年之前出门就再也没有回来，谁也不知道去了哪里？而宗主不在，就只剩下李寒舟这个副宗主。
但是原身根本就是个废物，没有什么修炼天赋，修为不高不说，还嗜赌如命，能当上副宗主，完全是因为是宗主的师弟。
宗主不在，原身已经将长生观里值钱的东西都给输完了，道观之中的弟子从一开始的几百人也就剩下现在四个人。
如今就快连饭也吃不起了。
外面还欠了八百两银子的外债。
还有不到七天，就是要还钱的日子了，若是还不上的话，要债的人是会上门打断李寒舟一双手的。
而前几日，太玄圣地举办的宗门大比，整个太玄圣地麾下的宗门弟子，修为达到五品的都可以参加，只要取得前一千名的成绩就奖励一千两白银。
宗门大弟子不在宗门，二弟子柳东岳刚刚五品。
勉强够参加的资格，于是原身就哄骗柳东岳去参加太玄圣地的宗门大比，但是柳东岳可不是傻子，他这个修为去参加根本就没有任何的竞争力，到时候说不定连命都丢了。
人家弟子要装备有装备，要丹药有丹药，要灵宝有灵宝的，自己穷的就剩个脑子了，去参加干嘛？
最后原身答应柳东岳给他制造一件灵宝，柳东岳才勉强答应下来。

Cangxuan Realm, the concept of longevity.
There is no incense in the Taoist temple, and it is dilapidated everywhere. The cracks in the blue bricks on the ground are covered with weeds. This place is more like a slum than a Taoist temple.
A desolate courtyard in a Taoist temple.
Li Hanzhou was in a daze in the house.
He never imagined that things would turn out like this.
He is not from the Cangxuan Realm, but from a place called Earth.
He had no father or mother since he was a child. He was picked up by an old Taoist priest and lived in a Taoist temple.
The old Taoist priest taught him Feng Shui physiognomy, fortune telling, drawing talismans to exorcise demons, and Taoist mental skills. However, in Li Hanzhou's opinion, these things are just deceptive tricks, just to defraud people of a meal. Where do monsters come from in this world?
There is also the Taoist Heart Technique. The old Taoist practiced it until his death without cultivating a ray of spiritual energy.
After the old Taoist priest passed away and the Taoist temple was demolished, Li Hanzhou had no choice but to rely on these skills to make a living.
At night, I live broadcast online to tell people's fortunes and read Feng Shui. During the day, I open a repair station to help people repair home appliances and so on.
Life was poor but he could still get by, and just three days ago, Li Hanzhou finally received God's favor. The lottery he bought actually won the lottery, winning a total of 30 million!
The money had arrived, and Li Hanzhou was pleasantly surprised to find that the Taoist mental method he had practiced for many years actually produced a ray of spiritual energy in his body. This made Li Hanzhou even more surprised. He did not expect that all the luck would appear on the same day!
However, with the appearance of this ray of spiritual energy, Li Hanzhou's vision went dark, and he appeared here when he woke up again.
He has traveled through time!
Li Hanzhou wanted to yell at God for playing such a trick on him.
I have 30 million, and my beautiful life is just about to begin, when I come to such a ghost place!
"Uncle Master, Uncle Master, are you okay? Tomorrow the assessment of Taixuan Holy Land will begin. Have you finished making your spiritual treasure?" At this time, an anxious voice came from outside the door.
Li Hanzhou looked out through the crack in the door and saw three people standing in the yard, two teenagers and a little girl.
"Hey, it's almost time. Wait a minute." Li Hanzhou could only say perfunctorily.
Turning around, Li Hanzhou had a headache.
This Immortality Temple is said to be a sect, but it has long been in extreme decline. The sect leader left the house a year ago and never came back. No one knows where he went? And without the sect leader, only Li Hanzhou, the deputy sect leader, was left.
But the original person is a waste at all. He has no cultivation talent, not to mention his low cultivation level, and is addicted to gambling. He became the deputy sect leader entirely because he is the sect leader's junior brother.
Without the sect master, the original person had lost all the valuable things in the Changsheng Temple. There were only four disciples left in the Taoist Temple from the hundreds at the beginning.
Now I can hardly even afford to eat.
There is also a foreign debt of 800 taels of silver.
There are less than seven days until the money is repaid. If the debt is not paid, the debtor will come to Li Hanzhou's house and interrupt Li Hanzhou's hands.
A few days ago, in the sect competition held by Taixuan Holy Land, all sect disciples under Taixuan Holy Land with a cultivation level of fifth level could participate. Anyone who ranked in the top 1,000 would be rewarded with 1,000 taels of silver.
The eldest disciple of the sect is not in the sect, and the second disciple Liu Dongyue has just reached the fifth rank.
He was barely qualified to participate, so he coaxed Liu Dongyue to participate in the sect competition in the Taixuan Holy Land. However, Liu Dongyue was not a fool. There was no competitiveness at all for his cultivation level to participate, and he might even lose his life by then.
Other disciples need equipment, elixirs, and spiritual treasures. If you are poor and have only a brain, why should you participate?
In the end, the original person promised Liu Dongyue to make him a spiritual treasure, and Liu Dongyue reluctantly agreed.
